content.short: Renfter is a decentralized uncollateralized NFT renting protocol.
content.description: Renfter aims to balance NFT-holding and non-holding communities while allowing NFT projects to unlock entirely new features to help them grow and scale. Renfter utilizes blockchain technology, specifically smart contracts, to power a renting protocol that does not rely on collateral as insurance and serves as a single source of trust.
